submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 with a threshold of 30 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.3% at the allocated 8 kHz rate, which is 6.1 percentage points better than Algorithm-L1 (86.2% at 35 GeV) and 17.7 percentage points better than Algorithm-L2 (74.6% at 35 GeV). 

The simulation study tested thresholds from 20-60 GeV across all three algorithms. For Algorithm-L3, 30 GeV is the optimal threshold, with efficiency declining at both lower thresholds (88.0% at 25 GeV) and higher thresholds (91.8% at 35 GeV, 90.7% at 40 GeV).

While Algorithm-L3 uses iterative topological clustering which is more complex than the alternatives, it is listed as an official candidate in the specifications document with confirmation that all candidates fit within FPGA resource budgets. The substantial performance gain makes it the optimal choice for maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate. Latency compliance should be verified during the implementation phase, though the algorithm's inclusion as a candidate suggests this requirement has been assessed.
